        md_lines.append(excerpt or "")
        items.append("\n".join(md_lines))
    digest = "# Recent Posts Digest\n\n" + "\n\n---\n\n".join(items) if items else ""
    if digest:
        print(digest)
    else:
        print(
            "compile_recent_posts_digest: no digest produced (no articles or empty result)."
        )
    return digest
